triggers.description: The user requests a new Codex skill and no existing skill is yet known to own the intent.
The user identifies an existing skill and a concrete package change or known defect.
The user asks whether, why, or how an existing skill should change from observed use, outcomes, or a regression.
The user requests software performance diagnosis or optimization, including a specified code optimization in edit mode; a skill package is not required.
exclusions: skill-only wording change without a performance objective

triggers.description: The user requests better agent-system task quality, reliability, latency, cost, or execution efficiency, including mixed prompt/tool/harness targets.
exclusions: skill activation question without an agent-performance objective

routes.description: Create one lean skill package after confirming no existing owner covers the intent.
Apply one coherent authorized intervention to an existing skill package.
Return one bounded expected delta and intervention without mutation.
Stop because an existing owner already covers creation intent, the package already satisfies the request, or no consequential delta is supported.
Stop because required target, authority, evidence, expected delta, or package boundary is missing.
Baseline and diagnose the selected software or agent target, then execute one authorized attributable experiment with protected-contract validation.
Retain a measured objective improvement after correctness or quality guardrails pass, then continue from the new baseline if the objective still requires work.
Reject an invalid or regressing candidate, restore only session-owned changes when authorized, and continue from the accepted baseline where justified.
Report a performance candidate as unverified or inconclusive when available measurements cannot establish its claimed effect; do not count it as an accepted gain.
Close with measured results and a stopping reason when the objective is met, no worthwhile supported candidate remains, or the authorized budget is exhausted.

success_signals: one lean package or an identified existing owner
aligned SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml
failure_signals: synonym skill created without search
instrumentation added without a decision need
clauses.rationale: Creation begins from an uncovered capability, not a preferred new package name.

success_signals: one coherent authorized intervention
stable contract IDs preserved
failure_signals: historical dossier manufactured for a known direct edit
unrelated package rewrite
clauses.rationale: A known skill change should proceed directly without inter-skill handoff ceremony.

success_signals: activation, decision influence, and outcome causality remain distinct
one dominant delta or no-change
failure_signals: raw mention treated as activation
successful outcome treated as causal proof
broad edit from weak evidence
clauses.rationale: Evidence-backed tuning must diagnose a consequential gap before mutation.

success_signals: weakest valid intervention supportable by current evidence
physical size considered only after semantic selection
failure_signals: description length used as a generalization proxy
unnecessary global rule
incomparability silently collapsed
clauses.rationale: Tune changes no more future behavior than the requested or evidenced delta requires.

required_artifacts: target objective, representative workload, and protected acceptance criteria
baseline and mechanism evidence or explicit execution limit
attributable experiment, before/after observations, and stopping reason
success_signals: target selects evidence and procedures before mutation
specified edits do not bypass performance validation
mixed targets share an objective and only load implicated guides
baseline shifts only after a supported accepted gain
failure_signals: software work requires skill-package discovery or activation history
optimization chosen from grep or fixed score without mechanism evidence
first win ends a still-incomplete requested objective
noisy or unmeasured change reported as verified improvement
clauses.rationale: Software and agent optimization share an evidence-driven loop without inheriting irrelevant skill-authoring prerequisites.

required_artifacts: fresh candidate compared against an independent baseline or specification
relevant output, error, effect, numerical, concurrency, and security checks
success_signals: preservation argument distinguished from executed evidence and residual uncertainty
approximation uses an existing allowance or explicit bounded authorization
local gains validated against the end-to-end objective
failure_signals: unchanged golden files treated as candidate verification
checklist or equal hashes claimed as universal equivalence proof
ordering, safety, security, or accuracy silently weakened
microbenchmark or asymptotic change presented as measured system speedup
clauses.rationale: Optimization must protect required observations and substantiate its actual performance claim, not merely change code.

required_artifacts: matched task evaluations and model/tool/configuration provenance
quality and reliability guards alongside latency/cost
attempt/failure denominators and relevant cache-state conditions
success_signals: task outcomes and resource costs jointly adjudicated
retry and failed-attempt costs included; zero-success cost per success is undefined
cold/warm/concurrent cache conditions and interference are disclosed
pinned model policy and human/tool authority preserved
failure_signals: fewer tokens or calls treated as sufficient evidence of improvement
hard failures omitted from latency or cost comparison
unobserved cache hits or live model efficacy invented
quality loss or changed model policy accepted silently
clauses.rationale: Agent efficiency is measured against successful outcomes rather than cheaper attempts or smaller prompts alone.

required_artifacts: permission for effectful workloads, paid evaluations, and evidence export when applicable
success_signals: inspect remains read-only and no-file-change requests produce no files
production load, spend, secrets, and external effects remain separately bounded
one experiment need not create a commit or new receipt
blocked effects do not stop independent authorized work
failure_signals: profiling writes or installation bypass an explicit no-file-changes request
optimization request treated as deployment or paid-API authority
shared history or unrelated files rewritten for rollback
clauses.rationale: A broader optimization surface does not broaden mutation, publication, privacy, or operational authority.

instrumentation.rationale: Use SDR-v1 only for consequential route decisions that bounded traces cannot recover proportionately.
